findings.description: All calls to the wrapped function now share and clear a single statistics dict (the one on wrapped_f) instead of each call getting its own copy's dict. Concurrent or nested calls overwrite and clear each other's stats.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a retry-decorated function is called from multiple threads, or recursively, at once. Mechanism: stats.clear() wipes the dict that an in-flight call's copy is still updating, and both calls write to the same dict. Impact: statistics (attempt_number, delay_since_first_attempt) are corrupted. A thread-local mechanism was previously used to avoid this.
